subject: Compact demo pod placement + wayfinding / collateral counts
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-09-12 09:05 -0700
Subject: Compact demo pod placement + wayfinding / collateral counts

Team —

Quick one as we finalize prep for ExpoNorth: the show gave us a smaller footprint (6x6) than last year and the event team recommended we move from a corner bay to a mid-aisle compact demo pod to cut build costs. Before I green-light the space swap I need:

- Confirmation that a 6x6 pod near Entrance B keeps our demo flow intact (we need clear sightlines for passersby).
- Signage plan: two 24" x 36" directional placards + one hanging 16" round ID (if allowed).
- Collateral counts: how many one-pagers, USB demo sticks, and swag sample packs do we want on the table (we usually overstock).
- AV: we will bring a single 27" monitor + laptop; confirm power and a short HDMI run.

I attached the compact_pod_floorplan_v2.pdf with a proposed placement and an initial collateral_pack_table_v3.xlsx. Can Marissa confirm headcount for booth shifts and Grace confirm power drop timing? Aditya — any objections on demo experience with the tighter sightline?

Goal: finalize by end of day Tuesday so we can submit the exhibitor portal update and ship on Friday.

Thanks,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0199
---
Attachments: compact_pod_floorplan_v2.pdf (layout), collateral_pack_table_v3.xlsx (counts)

From: Hannah Lee <hannah@expoplanners.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: ExpoNorth Exhibitor Portal <exhibitor@exponorth.com>
Date: 2027-09-12 11:28 -07:00
Subject: Re: Compact demo pod placement + wayfinding / collateral counts

Hi Tessa —

Thanks for the quick brief. The mid-aisle 6x6 is a common pod layout this year; it has slightly more natural foot traffic than the corner bay we initially held but does require tighter wayfinding to channel demo attendees. Notes from the floor ops team:

- Placement: See attached floorplan_v2 with the proposed pod at Grid F12 (approx. 12 ft from Entrance B). We can nudge it one bay left to improve sightlines to the corridor.
- Hanging ID: Limited to 16" round signs in this hall; you are allowed one. You must submit the hanging request by 2027-09-20.
- Power: You have a single 20A general power drop assigned. If you need dedicated AV power we can upgrade for $150 (order via the exhibitor portal).
- Rigging/AV labor window: Monday 09/27 08:00–12:00 (onsite labor billable).

Attachments: wayfinding_strip-map.png (shows recommended floor decals & directional strips).

I also looped Freeman for shipping notes — replace the crate label with the exhibitor_id RNF-342 and include the DocuSign shipping authorization (we'll need that signed before they unload).

If you want, we can run a small 3D render for sightline checks for $85 — helps verify monitor visibility from 15 ft.

Best,
Hannah Lee
Exhibits Coordinator, Expo Planners
---
Attachment: wayfinding_strip-map.png

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Hannah Lee <hannah@expoplanners.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-13 15:03 -07:00
Subject: Re: Compact demo pod placement + wayfinding / collateral counts

Thanks Hannah — that all looks reasonable. A couple of internal items:

- Headcount: We will staff the pod with 2 product engineers + 1 AE per shift. Shifts: 10:30–1:30, 1:30–4:30. Total crew 6 people across the day.
- Collateral: Recommend we bring 150 one-pagers, 80 demo USB sticks, and 120 swag sample packs (lawn stickers + stickers + 100ml sanitizer bottles). I updated the collateral_pack_table_v3.xlsx and attached.
- Signage: Approve the two 24x36 directional placards (place them on the aisle-side stands). Skip the hanging ID if it adds cost; we can use a tall pop-up blade instead.
- AV: Keep the single 27" monitor; skip paid AV upgrade. We tested the demo on a 15 ft sightline last month and it was still readable with increased font sizes.

Tessa — can you confirm you’ll submit the portal update today? I can sign any shipping auths. Also Aditya — quick sanity check that demo performance is OK when we reduce pod footprint by half.

-M

Marissa Cole
Events Lead, Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: collateral_pack_table_v3_filled.xlsx

Hi Marissa / Tessa —

Freeman here. Confirming pickup and inbound window:

- Pickup from Redwood SF warehouse (256 Transit Ave) on 2027-09-24 between 08:00–12:00. Please have crate labeled RNF-342 and include a packing list (we received your collateral_pack_table_v3_filled.xlsx).
- Arrival at expo dock: 2027-09-26 07:00–12:00. Onsite drayage rates attached in exhibitor portal; expedited offload is available for $220.
- Please upload signed DocuSign shipping authorization (DocuSign link in the thread) before 2027-09-22 to avoid hold.

Small note: make sure any pop-up blade stands are shrink-wrapped and listed as "freight: accessory" so they ride with the crate. If you want us to store a small box of extra one-pagers at the Freeman storage desk, mark it as StorageBox-1 in the packing list.
